create_QtNodeConfig: create a QtNodeConfig with a module name and optional window size tuple or FULLSCREEN
run_QtNode: run the QtNode to start a PyQt5 application with a MainWindow and graphics scene
subscribe_QtNode_current_trial: subscribe to the CURRENT_TRIAL_TOPIC to receive and store incoming trial messages
publish_QtNode_ready: publish a ReadyMessage on the READY_TOPIC when the Qt application is initialized and ready
publish_QtNode_end_trial: publish an EndTrialMessage on the END_TRIAL_TOPIC when all QtStimulus items in the current trial are completed
